title: Prime Minister pays homage to Mahatma Ayyankali on his birth anniversary
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has paid homage to Mahatma Ayyankali on his birth anniversary, today. Shri Modi remembered Mahatma Ayyankali as a great pioneer of social justice, who dedicated his life to the empowerment and welfare of the marginalised. The Prime Minister highlighted his efforts to secure educational opportunities for the marginalised, improve the lives of agricultural workers and serve the poor.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
Paying homage to Mahatma Ayyankali on his birth anniversary!
He is remembered as a great pioneer of social justice. His efforts to secure educational opportunities for the marginalised, improve the lives of agricultural workers and serve the poor remain very inspiring. His life gives strength to all those working for social empowerment.

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to Mahatma Ayyankali on his birth anniversary on 28 August 2026. He praised Ayyankali as a pioneer of social justice who worked for the education of marginalised communities, upliftment of agricultural workers, and welfare of the poor.
enrichment.context: Mahatma Ayyankali (1863-1941) was a prominent social reformer from Kerala who led struggles for the rights of Dalits and other backward communities, particularly the Pulayar community, in erstwhile Travancore. He is remembered for organising agricultural labourers, advocating for their right to education, and leading movements against untouchability, including efforts to allow Dalit children entry into schools. His work is often studied alongside other Kerala social reformers like Sree Narayana Guru in the context of the broader socio-religious reform movements that laid the groundwork for social change in South India. This release is a routine ceremonial tribute by the Prime Minister and does not contain any new policy announcement.
